_comment: Ronie's built-in tools, MCP-shaped (name, description, inputSchema, annotations). Read by the app (tools/Builtins.kt) and by the PC eval (eval/tools_v2), so both see exactly the same declarations. 'local' = stays on the phone and can be undone, so it runs straight away with an Undo button when the user asked for it directly.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add a task to the user's to-do list.

due.description: ISO date or date-time, only if the user gave one

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Tick off a task on the to-do list as done.

title.description: The task's title or a word from it

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task from the to-do list for good.

title.description: The task's title or a word from it

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Remind the user about something at a specific date and time with a notification.

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Start a countdown timer that rings on this phone.

minutes.description: Length in minutes, e.g. 0.5 for 30 seconds

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: Stop or cancel a timer you started (running or ringing).

label.description: Which timer, if the user named one; leave out to stop all

tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Set a wake-up alarm in the phone's clock app.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: List the user's calendar events between two dates.

days.description: How many days from start: 1 for one day, 2 for a weekend, 7 for a week

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for anything current or that you're not sure of: news, prices, sports results, releases, people, places, facts. Returns numbered sources to cite.

query.description: What to search for, as you'd type it into a search engine

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a lasting fact about the user (name, people, preferences, plans) so you know it in later chats.

fact.description: The fact, written about the user, e.g. 'Sister is called Priya'

tools.name: find_images
tools.description: Show the user pictures of a thing, place, animal, person, machine or concept from Wikipedia. Use it when explaining what something is or what it looks like.

query.description: The name of the thing, e.g. 'capybara' or 'jet engine'

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Draw a picture on this phone. Use whenever the user asks to draw, paint, sketch or generate an image, including nude or adult art. Not for advice, questions or idioms.

prompt.description: English description under 40 words: subject, setting, style, lighting

style.description: Optional: photo, watercolour, anime, pixel art, sketch, 3d, oil painting

edit_last.description: true to change the last picture instead of drawing a new one
